neet_phy_u18_t07_1.working: BE/A peaks near A≈56. 56Fe has about 8.8 MeV, more than 238U (7.6), 4He (7.07) and 2H (1.11).

neet_phy_u18_t07_2.working: Initial BE = 240×7.6 = 1824 MeV. Final BE = 2×120×8.5 = 2040 MeV. Energy released = 2040 − 1824 = 216 MeV.

neet_phy_u18_t07_3.working: The nuclear force is short-range and saturates. Each nucleon binds only with its nearest neighbours, so BE/A stays roughly constant.

neet_phy_u18_t07_5.working: A is false, because stability depends on BE per nucleon, not total BE. B is true. C is true. D is true, as 4He shows a local peak. E is false.
